body:
Context: Issues #826, #270, and #715.
1. (#826) plugins/adlc-gemini/rails-checker.mjs TRUST_ROOT_RAILS includes .adlc/tickets/** and .adlc/sessions.lock/**, which do not glob-match bare directory paths .adlc, .adlc/tickets, or .adlc/sessions.lock, allowing a structured tool targeting the directory itself to pass checkRail().
2. (#270) plugins/adlc-gemini/commands/adlc-init.md step 6 tells consumers to copy docs/ci/rails-guard.yml without noting how to run npx @adlc/rails-guard-ci --base origin/main directly in consumer repos where docs/ci/rails-guard.yml and scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs are not installed locally.
3. (#715) packages/preflight/package.json and packages/preflight/README.md do not declare an os constraint or state that the bash and test-cmd checks require a POSIX environment (darwin, linux).
Changes:
1. Add ".adlc", ".adlc/tickets", and ".adlc/sessions.lock" to TRUST_ROOT_RAILS in plugins/adlc-gemini/rails-checker.mjs and add regression tests in plugins/adlc-gemini/test/decide.test.mjs.
2. Update plugins/adlc-gemini/commands/adlc-init.md step 6 to document both the ADLC repository workflow/script (docs/ci/rails-guard.yml and scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs as a required check) and the published npx @adlc/rails-guard-ci --base origin/main CLI command for consumer repositories, and pin it in plugins/adlc-gemini/test/docs-visibility.test.mjs.
3. Add "os": ["darwin", "linux"] to packages/preflight/package.json and document the POSIX requirement in packages/preflight/README.md, with a test in packages/preflight/test/os-and-docs.test.mjs.
Acceptance Criteria:
- AC1: checkRail denies structured mutations targeting .adlc, .adlc/tickets, and .adlc/sessions.lock.
- AC2: plugins/adlc-gemini/commands/adlc-init.md documents npx @adlc/rails-guard-ci alongside docs/ci/rails-guard.yml and scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs.
- AC3: packages/preflight/package.json declares os: ["darwin", "linux"] and packages/preflight/README.md documents the POSIX requirement.
- AC4: All tests and mutation-gate pass.
title: fix(adlc-gemini, preflight): freeze bare .adlc and .adlc/tickets dirs, clarify CI gate setup in adlc-init, and declare preflight POSIX os (#826, #270, #715)
